about.waf.title: WAF Signatures
about.waf.desc: Regex and semantic patterns matching SQLi, XSS, RCE, and other common attack payloads in the request body and path.
about.honeypot.title: Honeypot hits
about.honeypot.desc: Bait URLs that no real browser navigates to. Any access immediately scores the IP as a crawler or bot.
about.uafp.title: UA/JA4 mismatch
about.uafp.desc: TLS fingerprint (JA4) doesn't match the declared User-Agent — e.g., a Chrome UA from a Python requests TLS stack.
about.coordinated.title: For coordinated attacks
about.coordinated.desc: Multi-IP distributed activity is detected separately on the DDoS page, where endpoint-level patterns are aggregated.
